description: Invisible Unicode, parser hidden-text signals, and instruction-bearing comments.

rules.name: Hidden or invisible instruction content
rules.description: Parser or normalization signals indicate hidden or invisible content relevant to model instructions.

patterns: <!--[\s\S]{0,300}(?:ignore previous instructions|reveal system prompt|önceki talimatları yok say)[\s\S]{0,300}-->

<(?:div|span|p|section)[^>]{0,300}(?:display\s*:\s*none|visibility\s*:\s*hidden|hidden(?:\s|=|>))[^>]*>[\s\S]{0,500}(?:ignore previous instructions|disable mfa|reveal system prompt|önceki talimatları yok say|mfa'yı devre dışı bırak)[\s\S]{0,500}</(?:div|span|p|section)>

rules.remediation: Expose hidden text to trust-boundary checks and prevent it from becoming executable instruction context.

metadata.impact: Invisible instructions can evade human review.
